# GitHub loading mark

`GitHub_Invertocat_Black.svg` and `GitHub_Invertocat_White.svg` are unchanged files from the [official GitHub logo archive](https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip), retrieved on 27 September 2026. They identify the GitHub source while repository documents load.

Use follows the [GitHub Brand Toolkit](https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo): original black/white colors, proportions and geometry, without effects or implied endorsement. These brand assets are separate from MIT-licensed Octicons.
